input_provenance.format: GP vectors [field discriminant, polynomial coefficients highest degree first, ordinary class number, class-group elementary divisors], one field per line
input_provenance.distribution: Corrected PARI/GP version by Karim Belabas (2007); files distributed September 2008. These gzip files deterministically repack the unmodified downloaded GP text with mtime=0; byte identity is asserted for the decompressed source, not the upstream gzip wrapper.
input_provenance.completeness_external_input: The complete field enumeration within each published discriminant range is an external input from the corrected Bordeaux tables; this package validates and filters every source row but does not reprove the original field enumeration.
